selection_set: dev (16 positions of the seed-13 partition); PCA/SVD fitted on deltas at these positions x 21 time values (336 observations)
evaluation_set: the other 46 valid positions (seed-13 test + fit); disjoint from dev, but every position was analyzed in Phases 4.6-4.8, so this is exploratory
best_rank_rule: chosen on dev only: smallest k whose dev direct-goal rate is >= 0.95; tie-break higher dev path efficiency, then variant order pca, svd
